clips.text: … Guard of the District Os Columbia was shown at the an nual rifle shooting competitions of the local militia held last Sunday at the Tlfle range at Camp Simms, Congress Heights.

Juvenal says: “Our prayers should be for a sound mind in a healthy body.” St. Elizabeth’s Hospital offers facili ties for the instruction of students in psychiatry, neurology and kindred branches which are not excelled else where in this country.
Arrangements were completed at this meeting for the annual bazaar and sale of articles made by the dis abled veterans of St. Elizabeth’s and Walter Reed Hospitals.
For the benefit of their uniform fund, An&eostia Eagle courtmen will entertain at a dance Friday evening in Congress Heights auditorium.

To raise funds for the team, a dance is carded tonight at Congress Heights Auditorium.

note: Clips are machine-read text (OCR) from scanned Evening Star pages on the Library of Congress's Chronicling America, lightly cleaned (line-break hyphens rejoined, stray symbols removed); misspellings are the scanner's. Newspapers this old are public domain. Each clip links to its page at loc.gov. Clips that mention race, covenants, deed restrictions or slurs are skipped automatically (keyword list: race, races, racial, colored, coloured, negro, negroes, white only, whites only, for whites, white people, white persons, white residents, caucasian, segregation, segregated, covenant, covenants, restricted, restriction, restrictions, plus a list of slurs), because they need an editor's context; legal notices and lists of private individuals are skipped too.
